THE REALITY OF LEGAL OPERATIONS
growth shouldn’t create more complexity.
As firms grow, legal work becomes harder to coordinate. More cases, more people, and more technology often create disconnected information, inconsistent processes, and less visibility across the firm.
work is scattered.
Case data lives across documents, inboxes, and disconnected systems.
processes become harder to manage.
Handoffs and workarounds make ownership, deadlines, and next steps less clear.
leadership loses visibility.
Answers about your cases and operations take too long to find.
more technology creates more complexity.
Every new tool promises to solve one problem, but often creates another disconnected system, another login, and another place to search for information.

EXPLORE SOLUTIONS
every workflow. one place.
case management
Run every matter from intake through resolution in one connected workspace built to scale with your firm. Configure cases, automate workflows, and support millions of records without sacrificing performance.
Explore case management ➝
document management
Keep documents connected to the work around them. Organize, search, edit, and collaborate on files directly within your legal workflows.
Explore document management ➝
analytics and reporting
Turn case and operational data into real-time visibility. Build dashboards and reports that help your team answer questions faster and make informed decisions.
Explore analytics and reporting ➝
task management
Automate repetitive work and keep every matter moving. Configure workflows, assign tasks, and streamline operations with no-code automation.
Explore task management ➝
communications
Keep every conversation connected to the case. Manage emails, messages, notes, and calendars in one place so teams stay aligned.
Explore communications ➝
document generation
Generate accurate, consistent documents in bulk using connected case data to streamline document creation.
Explore document generation ➝
integrations
Connect Neostella with the tools your firm already relies on. Open APIs and real-time integrations keep your technology ecosystem working together.
Explore integrations ➝
intake CRM
Turn more prospects into clients with a connected intake experience. Capture leads, automate follow-up, and seamlessly transition qualified prospects into active cases.
Explore intake CRM ➝
AI solutions
Bring AI into the flow of legal work. Search cases naturally, generate summaries, surface insights, and connect the AI tools your firm already trusts.
Explore AI solutions ➝
time tracking
Capture billable time as work happens. Keep time, expenses, and billing connected so your team can invoice faster and recover more revenue.
Explore time tracking ➝
